subject: math

objective.text: Measure and estimate liquid volume on a vertical number line, like the marks on a beaker.

explanations.title: Make a measuring bottle
explanations.text: Pour 100 milliliters at a time and mark each new water level. 10 marks make 1 liter.

explanations.title: A vertical number line
explanations.text: The marks go up and down, like a number line standing up. Vertical means up and down.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Part 1 (S: It's going up and down instead of sideways.)

explanations.title: Halfway to a liter
explanations.text: The mark halfway to 1 liter is 500 milliliters. Use it to estimate: less than, more than, or about halfway.

explanations.title: Between two marks
explanations.text: 250 milliliters is halfway between the 200 and 300 marks. Use halfway points to estimate.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Part 2 (250 mL, 450 mL estimates)

examples.title: From 200 to 500 milliliters
examples.text: The bottle has 200 milliliters. Add 300 milliliters to reach 500. The water rises 3 marks.

examples.title: Compare barrels
examples.text: Barrel C holds 96 liters and Barrel B holds 68 liters. 96 minus 68 equals 28 liters more.

questions.text: 1 liter is 650 milliliters and how many more milliliters?
Subha drinks 4 large glasses of water each day. How many glasses does she drink in 7 days?
You pour 100 milliliters each time. How many times do you pour to make 1 liter?
What is the value of the mark halfway to 1 liter?
The bottle has 200 milliliters. Is it less than, more than, or about halfway to a liter?
The bottle has 200 milliliters. How many milliliters must you add to reach 500 milliliters?
Adding 300 milliliters makes the water rise how many marks?
The water is halfway between the 200 and 300 marks. About how many milliliters is that?
The bottle has 1 liter. You pour out 300 milliliters. How many milliliters are left?
Barrels hold A 75, B 68, C 96 and D 52 liters. Which barrel has the greatest capacity?
Ben's barrel holds about 70 liters. Barrels hold A 75, B 68, C 96, D 52 liters. Which did he most likely buy? Why?
Barrel C holds 96 liters. Barrel B holds 68 liters. How many more liters does Barrel C hold?
Gas tanks: large 74, medium 57, small 42 liters. How many more liters does the large tank hold than the small?
If we poured 10 milliliter cups instead of 100, would the halfway mark change? Why?

hints.text: Each mark on the bottle is 100 milliliters. Count the marks.

1 liter is 1,000 milliliters. What part adds on to make 1,000?

Skip-count and track the groups on your fingers.
